title: React Nepal Monthly Meetup
description:
Three short talks from local developers on routing, state management and testing, followed by an open Q&A.

Beginners are welcome. Bring a laptop if you want to follow the live coding session.

Tea and snacks are provided.

title: Koshi Street Food Festival
description:
More than 40 stalls serving regional dishes, from sel roti and chatamari to Dharan-style momo.

The ticket covers entry and a tasting card for five small plates. There is a separate kids' corner and live folk music in the evening.

title: Patan Durbar Square Photography Walk
description:
A small-group walk led by a working photographer. You will practise composition, using early morning light and shooting street portraits respectfully.

Any camera works, including a phone. The group is capped at 15 people so everyone gets feedback.

title: Phewa Lakeside 10K Run
description:
A flat 10 km route along the lake, with a 5 km option for first-time runners.

The fee includes a race bib, a finisher medal, water stations along the route and breakfast at the finish line.

title: Startup Pitch Night
description:
Eight early-stage teams pitch to a panel of investors and mentors. Each pitch is five minutes, followed by five minutes of questions.

This event is sold out. Join the contact list to hear about the next one.

title: Acoustic Evening at Bhanu Chowk
description:
An open-air evening of acoustic sets from six local bands and solo artists.

Entry is free. Bring a jacket, since it gets cold after sunset.

title: Pottery Basics for Beginners
description:
A hands-on session with a Thimi potter. You will learn centring, pulling up walls and finishing a small bowl on the wheel.

Your piece will be fired and ready for pickup a week later. Aprons are provided.

title: Purwanchal Campus Hackathon
description:
A 24-hour build event for students. Teams of up to four choose a problem from the list on the day and demo their work to the judges.

Food and drinks are provided throughout. Prizes for the top three teams.

title: Winter Art Fair
description:
Paintings, prints and sculpture from over 60 emerging Nepali artists, all for sale directly from the artists.

The fair also has two live painting demos and a children's sketching table.

title: Mountain Film Night
description: A screening of five short documentaries about life and climbing in the Himalayas, with a short talk from one of the directors after the last film.
